title: Understanding the Plot
text: Notice how the plot shows a U-shape. This suggests that as the value of $$d$$ increases, the y-axis value decreases to a minimum and then increases again. Think about what kind of metric in machine learning might behave this way as complexity increases.

title: Bias and Variance
text: Consider how bias and variance behave as model complexity changes. Bias typically decreases with more complexity, while variance increases. How might this relate to the U-shape of the plot?

title: Possible Y-Axis Labels
